memory_objects.canonical_definition: Isotopes are atoms of the same element with the same number of protons and different numbers of neutrons.
memory_objects.story_hint: same proton badge, different neutron crates

memory_objects.canonical_definition: Average atomic mass is the weighted average of the naturally occurring isotope masses using their fractional abundances.
memory_objects.story_hint: the balance multiplies each isotope mass by its fractional abundance before adding the contributions

memory_objects.canonical_definition: Atomic number is the number of protons in an atom's nucleus and identifies the element.
memory_objects.story_hint: the permanent proton badge on every atom of the element

memory_objects.canonical_definition: Mass number is the total number of protons and neutrons in a specific isotope.
memory_objects.story_hint: the headcount board adds protons and neutrons for one isotope
